theme_strategy: Precision Performance Dark & Slate High-Contrast (Modern Automotive Tech with Tactical Minimalism)

entry_surfaces./: split & asymmetric bento hero — NL vehicle query search prompt and prompt pill tags on top, sample matching trucks grid with live match scoring and Build Deal action below
entry_surfaces./deal/:vehicleId: split desking view — vehicle specifications & photo showcase left, dynamic deal structure calculator and trade module right
entry_surfaces./negotiate/:dealId: two-column interactive negotiation command center — live deal transcript with AI simulated dealer responses left, sticky action deck (counter, accept, decline) right
entry_surfaces./garage: bento vehicle asset deck — equity and valuation tracker top, maintenance/mileage update card and 'Shop with this Trade' action bottom
entry_surfaces./dealer: high-density desking cockpit — incoming deal queue with status badges, live dealer controls, and fast take-over trigger
entry_surfaces./dealer/settings: rules matrix panel — dealership-wide discount authority, floor limits, and per-VIN override table

layouts.spacing_philosophy: Generous tactical spacing with strict 1px high-contrast borders (#233044) and subtle rounded corners (rounded-xl)

visual_enhancers.tactical_badges: High contrast status indicators with subtle border glows (e.g., '96% Match', 'AI Negotiating', 'Dealer Counter')
visual_enhancers.dynamic_otd_summary: Sticky bottom bar on mobile or sticky sidebar on desktop showing real-time recalculated Out-The-Door (OTD) pricing
visual_enhancers.ai_negotiation_ticker: Simulated typing indicator with realistic latency and conversational dealer counteroffers with dealer rule engine behind the scenes

accessibility.min_contrast_ratio: 4.5:1 for body copy against all surfaces, 3:1 for large headers
accessibility.interactive_targets: Minimum 44px by 44px clickable areas for buttons and toggles
accessibility.data_testids: Strict kebab-case role-based identifiers on every actionable and status node

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Role Switcher: Implement a global header switcher (toggle/pills) to flip between 'Consumer Experience' and 'Dealer Experience' anytime with active badge.

2. Natural Language Vehicle Search: Provide the search box with preset prompts ('GMC Denali 1500', 'Ford F-150 hybrid under 50k', 'Toyota Tundra crew cab'). When 'GMC Denali 1500' is submitted, explicitly highlight 'Interpreted as GMC Sierra 1500 Denali (98% match)'.

3. Four Matching Trucks: Render GMC Sierra 1500 Denali, Ford F-150 Lariat, Ram 1500 Limited, and Toyota Tundra 1794 with Match %, Selling Price, Mileage, Distance, Key Features tags, and 'Build Deal' CTA button.

4. Build Deal flow: Real-time math breakdown showing Selling Price, Manufacturer Incentives (-$3,250), Dealer Doc Fee ($699), Estimated Tax/Title (e.g. 7.5%), and OTD Total. Allow down payment adjustment.

5. Add Trade-in Module: VIN input (with auto-populate button or sample VINs), Year/Make/Model, Mileage, Estimated Payoff, Condition selector (Excellent, Clean, Fair), photo upload placeholders, dynamic trade valuation estimate ($32,000 - $35,500), and auto-calculated positive or negative equity applied directly to the deal.

6. AI Negotiation Simulation: Customer enters offer price. Trigger dynamic AI negotiation responses based on dealer rules. Dealer rules include Advertised Price, AI Discount Authority, Manager Approval threshold, and Hard Floor. Provide simulated dealer counteroffer messages with 'Accept Deal', 'Counter Again', and 'Decline Deal' options.

7. Deal Accepted + Appointment Booking: Once deal is accepted, show confirmation celebration state, summary deal sheet, and interactive test drive/delivery appointment scheduler (calendar date, time slots, dealer address).

8. My Garage: Add purchased or trade vehicle to 'My Garage' showing Current Market Value, Loan Payoff, Net Equity gauge, 'Update Mileage' modal, 'Refresh Value' calculation, and 'Shop With This Trade' button jumping into search with pre-loaded equity.

9. Dealer Portal: Dashboard with incoming customer deals, Deal status badges (Pending AI, Customer Countered, Manager Review, Accepted, Closed), Deal Detail view with customer offer, trade valuation, profit breakdown, and action buttons: 'Accept', 'Counter', 'Decline', 'Take Over (Direct Desking)'.

10. Dealer Negotiation Settings: Dealer Settings page with sliders and inputs for Default AI Discount Authority ($), Manager Threshold ($), Hard Floor ($), Max Deviation (%), plus a per-VIN/Vehicle override table allowing custom rules on high-demand trucks.

11. All interactive elements MUST have explicit data-testid attributes (e.g. data-testid='nl-search-input', data-testid='build-deal-btn-1', data-testid='submit-offer-btn', data-testid='accept-deal-btn', data-testid='role-switcher-dealer').
